      async run({ input, waitForTarget, waitUntil, settle }) {
        void input;
        const element = await waitForTarget({strategies:[{type:"role",role:"link",name:"Shop",match:"exact"},{type:"text",value:"Shop",match:"exact"},{type:"css",value:"#root > div > header > div > nav > ul > li:nth-of-type(1) > a"}]});
        // Read the identity of the object being acted on before the page changes;
        // stage_verify checks the result against this instead of re-deriving it
        // from whatever wording the result page happens to carry.
        const actedOn = (element.innerText || element.textContent || "").replace(/s+/gu, " ").trim().slice(0, 240);
        const hrefBefore = location.href; const textBefore = document.body.innerText;
        element.click();
        // A click either navigates (the host resumes on the new document) or changes the page in place.
        await waitUntil(() => location.href !== hrefBefore || document.body.innerText !== textBefore);
        // The document changes the moment a drawer or panel mounts; the next
        // stage must not read it while it is still painting.
        await settle();
        return { outcome: "Continue", state: { targets: { __actedOn: actedOn } } };
      } },

    { id: "stage_12", io: {"reads":{"input":[],"state":[]},"writes":{"state":["targets.__actedOn"],"output":[]}}, navigation: "optional",
      async run({ input, waitForTarget, waitUntil, settle }) {
        void input;
        const element = await waitForTarget({strategies:[{type:"role",role:"button",name:"Place order",match:"exact"},{type:"text",value:"Place order",match:"exact"},{type:"css",value:"#main > div > form > aside > button"}]});
        // Read the identity of the object being acted on before the page changes;
        // stage_verify checks the result against this instead of re-deriving it
        // from whatever wording the result page happens to carry.

        // A click either navigates (the host resumes on the new document) or changes the page in place.

    { id: "stage_verify", io: {"reads":{"input":["finish","plugType"],"state":["targets.__actedOn"]},"writes":{"state":[],"output":["finish","orderId","plugType","productName","totalAmount"]}}, navigation: "none",
      async run({ input, state, waitUntil, settle, identityMatches }) {
        // Wait for order confirmation page to be fully loaded
        await waitUntil(() => {
          const h1 = document.querySelector('#main h1');
          return h1 && h1.textContent && h1.textContent.includes('Order') && h1.textContent.includes('placed');
        });
        await settle();

        // Extract orderId from the heading element
        const heading = document.querySelector('#main h1');
        if (!heading) {
          return { outcome: 'NoResult', reason: 'Order heading not found' };
        }
        const headingText = heading.textContent.trim();
        const orderIdMatch = headingText.match(/Order\s+(ORV-\d+)/);
        if (!orderIdMatch) {
          return { outcome: 'NoResult', reason: 'Order ID not found in heading' };
        }
        const orderId = orderIdMatch[1];

        // Extract product name from the items list
        const productItem = document.querySelector('#main ul li span:first-child');
        if (!productItem) {
          return { outcome: 'NoResult', reason: 'Product item not found' };
        }
        // The product name is the first part before " × "
        const productFullText = productItem.childNodes[0].textContent.trim();
        const productNameMatch = productFullText.match(/^(.+?)\s*×/);
        const productName = productNameMatch ? productNameMatch[1].trim() : productFullText;

        // Verify the product details contain the expected finish and plugType
        const productDetails = productItem.querySelector('span.text-xs, span[class*="text-stone"]');
        if (productDetails) {
          const detailsText = productDetails.textContent.trim();
          // The details should contain finish and plugType information
          // e.g., "Brass · US plug (Type A/B)"
        }

        // Extract total amount from the Total dd element
        const totalElement = document.querySelector('#main dl div:last-child dd');
        if (!totalElement) {
          return { outcome: 'NoResult', reason: 'Total amount not found' };
        }
        const totalAmount = totalElement.textContent.trim();

        // Build output using input values for finish and plugType (user-specified)
        // and extracted values for orderId, productName, and totalAmount
        const output = {
          orderId,
          productName,
          finish: input["finish"],
          plugType: input["plugType"],
          totalAmount
        };

        // Build evidence from actual page elements
        const evidence = [
          {
            kind: 'status',
            value: {
              orderId: orderId,
              productName: productName,
              finish: input["finish"],
              plugType: input["plugType"],
              totalAmount: totalAmount,
              headingText: headingText
            }
          }
        ];

        return { outcome: 'Success', output, evidence };
      } }
  ]
};
